guides.title: iPhone & iPad Basics: Control Center, App Library, & Default Apps
guides.symptom: New to iPhone, don't know where settings are, or links open in Safari instead of Chrome
guides.description: Navigate iOS gestures with ease: swipe gestures, Control Center, App Library, Spotlight search, and configuring default web and email applications.
causes: Unfamiliarity with gesture bar swipes vs home button
iOS defaulting links and email to Safari and Apple Mail
guides.whyItWorks: iOS allows third-party browsers and mail clients to register as system default handlers in Settings, routing all universal links seamlessly.

steps.instruction: Access Control Center and Spotlight Search
steps.detail: On iPhones without a Home button: swipe DOWN from the top-right corner (where the battery icon is) to open Control Center (brightness, volume, flashlight, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth). To search anything, swipe down from the middle of any Home screen to invoke Spotlight search.

steps.instruction: Change default browser on iPhone (Safari to Chrome)
steps.detail: Go to Settings > scroll down and tap 'Chrome' (or your preferred browser) > tap 'Default Browser App' > select Chrome. All web links from Messages, WhatsApp, and Mail will now open directly in Chrome.

steps.instruction: Find all apps in the App Library
steps.detail: Swipe left past all your Home Screen pages until you reach the 'App Library'. Here, all your apps are automatically categorized into folders, with a search bar at the top to find any installed app even if hidden from your home screen.

guides.title: Fixing 'iPhone Storage Full' & Purging Huge 'System Data'
guides.symptom: iPhone shows 'iPhone Storage Full' alert, or 'System Data' takes 20GB+ in storage breakdown
guides.description: Reclaim gigabytes of iPhone storage by clearing Safari website data, purging streaming offline caches, and shrinking bloated System Data.
causes: Safari database and media cache accumulating gigabytes of website data
Downloaded offline podcasts, music, and streaming video caches
Unsynced local photo thumbnails and failed iCloud sync logs
guides.whyItWorks: iOS classifies cached media, diagnostic logs, and Siri voices as 'System Data'. Clearing browser storage and temporarily restarting the device prompts iOS to flush unreferenced temporary caches.

steps.detail: Go to Settings > General > iPhone Storage. Wait a few seconds for the graph to calculate. Review which apps use the most space. Enable 'Offload Unused Apps' to automatically remove the app binary while preserving your documents and data.

steps.instruction: Clear Safari website data and cache
steps.detail: Go to Settings > Safari > scroll down and tap 'Clear History and Website Data' > select 'All history' and tap 'Clear History'. This frequently frees 2GB to 8GB of bloated cached media instantly.

steps.instruction: Perform a forced restart to flush System Data caches
steps.detail:
Performing a hard restart forces iOS to purge temporary log files in System Data:
1. Press and quickly release Volume UP
2. Press and quickly release Volume DOWN
3. Press and HOLD the Side (Power) button until the Apple logo appears, then release.
